title: An induction study to investigate the efficacy and safety of duvakitug in participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease
official: A multicenter, multinational, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3, induction study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of duvakitug in participants with moderately to severely active Crohn’s Disease
summary: Main objective: Sub-Study 2: To assess the efficacy of duvakitug as induction therapy in participants with moderately to severely active CD compared with placebo.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants aged ≥18 and ≤80 years of age at Screening. Where permitted locally, participants 16 to <18 years of age who meet the definition of Tanner Stage 5 for development
2. Confirmed diagnosis of moderately to severely active Crohn’s Disease (CD) for at least 3 months prior to baseline
3. Demonstrated inadequate response, have shown loss of response or intolerance to conventional therapies or advanced therapies (ATs)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants with Ulcerative Colitis (UC) or indeterminate colitis
2. Participants with two entire missing segments of the: terminal ileum, right colon transverse colon, sigmoid and left colon, and rectum
3. Prior or current high-grade gastrointestinal (GI) dysplasia
4. Participants on treatment with but not on stable doses of conventional therapy prior to baseline
5. Participants receiving prohibited medications or therapies
6. Participants with previous exposure to anti-TL1A investigational therapy
